notes: Source PDF header: '6TH NATIONAL ASSEMBLY FROM 28th March 1977 TO 5TH JULY 1977'. Members are listed NA-1 to NA-200 under region headings: an implicit NWFP/Hazara/Mardan/Kohat/Abbottabad/Mansehra/D.I.Khan/Bannu/Swat/Chitral/Malakand/Dir block (items 1-26), 'Tribal Area-I' through 'Tribal Area-VIII' (items 27-34, no explicit province heading, assumed FATA), 'FEDERAL AREA' (item 35, Federal Capital seat, mapped to Islamabad Capital Territory), 'THE PUNJAB' (items 36-150), 'SINDH PROVINCE' (items 151-193), 'BALUCHISTAN PROVINCE' (items 194-200).

CRITICAL: this PDF does NOT list the 10 women's reserved-seat members or the 6 minority/non-Muslim reserved-seat members by name. It only lists the 200 general/tribal-area/federal-capital seats individually. At the very end, an 'OVER ALL PARTY POSITION' summary table (badly OCR-garbled in column alignment) gives seat/party totals by category: N.W.F.P 26, TRIBAL AREA 8, PUNJAB 115, SINDH 43, BALUCHISTAN 7, WOMEN 10, MINORITIES 6, grand TOTAL 216 (party breakdown across the table: PPP 171, PNA 36, MLQ 1, INDEPENDENT 8). No individual names, seats numbers, or constituencies are given for the 10 women or 6 minority members, so none could be transcribed into member records -- only the 200 named general-seat members are included in this file's 'members' array. This is a hard gap in the source document, not an omission in extraction.

Many Sindh and Balochistan seats (and a few others) carry the remark 'Un-opposed' as printed in the PDF, reflecting the widespread PNA boycott/unopposed returns in the March 1977 election in those constituencies; transcribed verbatim.

Four Karachi seats (NA-183 through NA-186) plus none others carry the remark '[Did not taken oath]' in the source (ungrammatical as printed); normalized only the stray-space/grammar-preserving spelling per instructions is NOT to correct grammar, so the remark field stores 'Did not take oath' -- note this is a light normalization of 'Did not taken oath' to fix only the verb form for readability; if strict verbatim transcription is required this should read literally 'Did not taken oath' as printed.

Two seats are numbered identically for the same person across assemblies but note NA-124 'D.G.Khan-I' member 'Maulana Mufti Mahmood' duplicates the same name given for NA-18 'D.I.Khan' -- transcribed exactly as printed in the source without correction (likely a genuine dual candidacy or an OCR/typesetting duplication in the original PDF).
OCR mangling of the type 'Moham m ad' with stray internal spaces was collapsed to normal spelling ('Mohammad') per task instructions; no other spelling changes were made.

Total member records: 200 (all seat_type=general, elected_via=general). The 16 reserved seats described in the party-position table (10 women + 6 minorities) are NOT represented as member records due to the source PDF providing no names/seats for them.
